title: Mechanistic Anomaly Detection on a Backdoored Tiny Model: A Minimal MAD Benchmark

original_idea.body:
# Minimal MAD Benchmark

Train a backdoored tiny classifier; implement activation-distance MAD baselines, measure AUROC for triggered inputs.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: backdoors are canonical 'right answer wrong reason' central to MAD and deceptive-model detection.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Tiny backdoored classifier plus simple activation-distance detectors; accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped micro-benchmark with AUROC success criteria.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Neglected reproducible MAD micro-benchmark/infra, needs no internal access, benefits external scrutiny.

novelty.reasoning: Backdoor detection is studied broadly but an accessible from-scratch MAD micro-benchmark may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Backdoor anomaly detection exists; the minimal MAD micro-benchmark framing may be open.
